_comment: Chain configuration. `configured` is true only when a committer has actually published receipts for this deployment — the page reads it to decide whether VERIFY checks the chain or only recomputes locally.
_rpc_note: api.mainnet-beta.solana.com returns 403 to browser requests, so it cannot be used from the page. This endpoint serves getTransaction cross-origin.
_wallet_note: Pays the per-window transaction fees, which is what the life support panel measures. This is the committer's own key, not the treasury: funded from HPZu33CXGdgtA7rmw5DCkNVaZ9nNUmzi39Hueh69VDb5, which pays nothing itself and so would make that panel read falsely.
